rationale: Identity was properly verified using full name and zip, and the agent worked only on the authenticated user’s orders. Order #W6750959 was pending, so address and item modifications were permissible. However, the agent changed the delivery address to the NYC address without first obtaining explicit user confirmation after stating the exact address, violating the requirement to confirm before any order-changing write. For the Bluetooth speaker change, the agent correctly identified the least expensive available green variant, requested and received explicit confirmation, and updated the item appropriately; stating a refund occurred is plausible given the lower price and payment method provided, though not explicitly confirmed by the tool response. The lack of confirmation before the address change fails the policy’s pass bar.
